88: @HandlerPriority(-1024) //-2^10; to ensure we've picked up @FieldDefault's changes (-2048) but @Value hasn't removed itself yet (-512), so that we can error on presence of it on the builder classes.
89: public class HandleSuperBuilder extends JavacAnnotationHandler<SuperBuilder> {
90: 	private static final String SELF_METHOD = "self";
91: 	private static final String FILL_VALUES_METHOD_NAME = "$fillValuesFrom";
92: 	private static final String STATIC_FILL_VALUES_METHOD_NAME = "$fillValuesFromInstanceIntoBuilder";
93: 	private static final String INSTANCE_VARIABLE_NAME = "instance";
94: 	private static final String BUILDER_VARIABLE_NAME = "b";
95: 	
96: 	class SuperBuilderJob extends BuilderJob {
97: 		JavacNode builderAbstractType;
98: 		String builderAbstractClassName;
99: 		JavacNode builderImplType;
100: 		String builderImplClassName;
101: 		List<JCTypeParameter> builderTypeParams_;
102: 		
103: 		void init(AnnotationValues<SuperBuilder> annValues, SuperBuilder ann, JavacNode node) {
104: 			accessOuters = accessInners = AccessLevel.PUBLIC;
105: 			oldFluent = true;
106: 			oldChain = true;
107: 			
108: 			builderMethodName = ann.builderMethodName();
109: 			buildMethodName = ann.buildMethodName();
110: 			toBuilder = ann.toBuilder();
111: 			
112: 			if (builderMethodName == null) builderMethodName = "builder";
113: 			if (buildMethodName == null) buildMethodName = "build";
114: 			builderClassName = getBuilderClassNameTemplate(node, null);
115: 		}
116: 		
117: 		void setBuilderToImpl() {
118: 			builderType = builderImplType;
119: 			builderClassName = builderImplClassName;
120: 			builderTypeParams = typeParams;
121: 		}
122: 		
123: 		void setBuilderToAbstract() {
124: 			builderType = builderAbstractType;
125: 			builderClassName = builderAbstractClassName;
126: 			builderTypeParams = builderTypeParams_;
127: 		}
128: 	}
129: 	
130: 	@Override
131: 	public void handle(AnnotationValues<SuperBuilder> annotation, JCAnnotation ast, JavacNode annotationNode) {
132: 		handleExperimentalFlagUsage(annotationNode, ConfigurationKeys.SUPERBUILDER_FLAG_USAGE, "@SuperBuilder");
133: 		SuperBuilderJob job = new SuperBuilderJob();
134: 		job.sourceNode = annotationNode;
135: 		job.checkerFramework = getCheckerFrameworkVersion(annotationNode);
136: 		job.isStatic = true;
137: 		
138: 		SuperBuilder annInstance = annotation.getInstance();
139: 		
140: 		job.init(annotation, annInstance, annotationNode);
141: 		
142: 		boolean generateBuilderMethod;
143: 		if (job.builderMethodName.isEmpty()) {
144: 			generateBuilderMethod = false;
145: 		} else if (!checkName("builderMethodName", job.builderMethodName, annotationNode)) {
146: 			return;
147: 		} else {
148: 			generateBuilderMethod = true;
149: 		}
150: 		if (!checkName("buildMethodName", job.buildMethodName, annotationNode)) return;
151: 		
152: 		// Do not delete the SuperBuilder annotation here, we need it for @Jacksonized.
153: 		
154: 		JavacNode parent = annotationNode.up();
155: 		
156: 		job.builderFields = new ArrayList<BuilderFieldData>();
157: 		job.typeParams = List.nil();
158: 		List<JCExpression> buildMethodThrownExceptions = List.nil();
159: 		List<JCExpression> superclassTypeParams = List.nil();
160: 		boolean addCleaning = false;
161: 		
162: 		if (!isClass(parent)) {
163: 			annotationNode.addError("@SuperBuilder is only supported on classes.");
164: 			return;
165: 		}
166: 		if (!isStaticAllowed(parent)) {
167: 			annotationNode.addError("@SuperBuilder is not supported on non-static nested classes.");
168: 			return;
169: 		}
170: 		
171: 		job.parentType = parent;
172: 		JCClassDecl td = (JCClassDecl) parent.get();
173: 		
174: 		// Gather all fields of the class that should be set by the builder.
175: 		ArrayList<JavacNode> nonFinalNonDefaultedFields = null;
176: 		
177: 		boolean valuePresent = (hasAnnotation(lombok.Value.class, parent) || hasAnnotation("lombok.experimental.Value", parent));
178: 		for (JavacNode fieldNode : HandleConstructor.findAllFields(parent, true)) {
179: 			JCVariableDecl fd = (JCVariableDecl) fieldNode.get();
180: 			JavacNode isDefault = findAnnotation(Builder.Default.class, fieldNode, false);
181: 			boolean isFinal = (fd.mods.flags & Flags.FINAL) != 0 || (valuePresent && !hasAnnotation(NonFinal.class, fieldNode));
182: 			BuilderFieldData bfd = new BuilderFieldData();
183: 			bfd.rawName = fd.name;
184: 			bfd.name = removePrefixFromField(fieldNode);
185: 			bfd.builderFieldName = bfd.name;
186: 			bfd.annotations = findCopyableAnnotations(fieldNode);
187: 			bfd.type = fd.vartype;
188: 			bfd.singularData = getSingularData(fieldNode, annInstance.setterPrefix());
189: 			bfd.originalFieldNode = fieldNode;
190: 			
191: 			if (bfd.singularData != null && isDefault != null) {
192: 				isDefault.addError("@Builder.Default and @Singular cannot be mixed.");
193: 				findAnnotation(Builder.Default.class, fieldNode, true);
194: 				isDefault = null;
195: 			}
196: 			
197: 			if (fd.init == null && isDefault != null) {
198: 				isDefault.addWarning("@Builder.Default requires an initializing expression (' = something;').");
199: 				findAnnotation(Builder.Default.class, fieldNode, true);
200: 				isDefault = null;
201: 			}
202: 			
203: 			if (fd.init != null && isDefault == null) {
204: 				if (isFinal) continue;
205: 				if (nonFinalNonDefaultedFields == null) nonFinalNonDefaultedFields = new ArrayList<JavacNode>();
206: 				nonFinalNonDefaultedFields.add(fieldNode);
207: 			}
208: 			
209: 			if (isDefault != null) {
210: 				bfd.nameOfDefaultProvider = parent.toName(DEFAULT_PREFIX + bfd.name);
211: 				bfd.nameOfSetFlag = parent.toName(bfd.name + SET_PREFIX);
212: 				bfd.builderFieldName = parent.toName(bfd.name + VALUE_PREFIX);
213: 				JCMethodDecl md = HandleBuilder.generateDefaultProvider(bfd.nameOfDefaultProvider, fieldNode, td.typarams, job);
214: 				if (md != null) injectMethod(parent, md);
215: 			}
216: 			addObtainVia(bfd, fieldNode);
217: 			job.builderFields.add(bfd);
218: 		}
219: 		
220: 		job.typeParams = job.builderTypeParams = td.typarams;
221: 		job.builderClassName = job.replaceBuilderClassName(td.name);
222: 		if (!checkName("builderClassName", job.builderClassName, annotationNode)) return;
223: 		
224: 		// <C, B> are the generics for our builder.
225: 		String classGenericName = "C";
226: 		String builderGenericName = "B";
227: 		// We have to make sure that the generics' names do not collide with any generics on the annotated class,
228: 		// the classname itself, or any member type name of the annotated class.
229: 		// For instance, if there are generics <B, B2, C> on the annotated class, use "C2" and "B3" for our builder.
230: 		java.util.HashSet<String> usedNames = gatherUsedTypeNames(job.typeParams, td);
231: 		classGenericName = generateNonclashingNameFor(classGenericName, usedNames);
232: 		builderGenericName = generateNonclashingNameFor(builderGenericName, usedNames);
233: 		
234: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = annotationNode.getTreeMaker();
235: 		
236: 		{
237: 			JCExpression annotatedClass = namePlusTypeParamsToTypeReference(maker, parent, job.typeParams);
238: 			JCTypeParameter c = maker.TypeParameter(parent.toName(classGenericName), List.<JCExpression>of(annotatedClass));
239: 			ListBuffer<JCExpression> typeParamsForBuilder = getTypeParamExpressions(job.typeParams, maker, job.sourceNode);
240: 			typeParamsForBuilder.append(maker.Ident(parent.toName(classGenericName)));
241: 			typeParamsForBuilder.append(maker.Ident(parent.toName(builderGenericName)));
242: 			JCTypeApply typeApply = maker.TypeApply(namePlusTypeParamsToTypeReference(maker, parent, job.getBuilderClassName(), false, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil()), typeParamsForBuilder.toList());
243: 			JCTypeParameter d = maker.TypeParameter(parent.toName(builderGenericName), List.<JCExpression>of(typeApply));
244: 			if (job.typeParams == null || job.typeParams.isEmpty()) {
245: 				job.builderTypeParams_ = List.of(c, d);
246: 			} else {
247: 				job.builderTypeParams_ = job.typeParams.append(c).append(d);
248: 			}
249: 		}
250: 		
251: 		JCTree extendsClause = Javac.getExtendsClause(td);
252: 		JCExpression superclassBuilderClass = null;
253: 		if (extendsClause instanceof JCTypeApply) {
254: 			// Remember the type arguments, because we need them for the extends clause of our abstract builder class.
255: 			superclassTypeParams = ((JCTypeApply) extendsClause).getTypeArguments();
256: 			// A class name with a generics type, e.g., "Superclass<A>".
257: 			extendsClause = ((JCTypeApply) extendsClause).getType();
258: 		}
259: 		if (extendsClause instanceof JCFieldAccess) {
260: 			Name superclassName = ((JCFieldAccess) extendsClause).getIdentifier();
261: 			String builderClassNameTemplate = BuilderJob.getBuilderClassNameTemplate(annotationNode, null);
262: 			String superclassBuilderClassName = job.replaceBuilderClassName(superclassName.toString(), builderClassNameTemplate);
263: 			superclassBuilderClass = parent.getTreeMaker().Select(cloneType(maker, (JCFieldAccess) extendsClause, annotationNode), parent.toName(superclassBuilderClassName));
264: 		} else if (extendsClause != null) {
265: 			String builderClassNameTemplate = BuilderJob.getBuilderClassNameTemplate(annotationNode, null);
266: 			String superclassBuilderClassName = job.replaceBuilderClassName(extendsClause.toString(), builderClassNameTemplate);
267: 			superclassBuilderClass = chainDots(parent, extendsClause.toString(), superclassBuilderClassName);
268: 		}
269: 		
270: 		// Check validity of @ObtainVia fields, and add check if adding cleaning for @Singular is necessary.
271: 		for (BuilderFieldData bfd : job.builderFields) {
272: 			if (bfd.singularData != null && bfd.singularData.getSingularizer() != null) {
273: 				if (bfd.singularData.getSingularizer().requiresCleaning()) {
274: 					addCleaning = true;
275: 					break;
276: 				}
277: 			}
278: 			if (bfd.obtainVia != null) {
279: 				if (bfd.obtainVia.field().isEmpty() == bfd.obtainVia.method().isEmpty()) {
280: 					bfd.obtainViaNode.addError("The syntax is either @ObtainVia(field = \"fieldName\") or @ObtainVia(method = \"methodName\").");
281: 					return;
282: 				}
283: 				if (bfd.obtainVia.method().isEmpty() && bfd.obtainVia.isStatic()) {
284: 					bfd.obtainViaNode.addError("@ObtainVia(isStatic = true) is not valid unless 'method' has been set.");
285: 					return;
286: 				}
287: 			}
288: 		}
289: 		
290: 		job.builderAbstractClassName = job.builderClassName = job.replaceBuilderClassName(td.name);
291: 		job.builderImplClassName = job.builderAbstractClassName + "Impl";
292: 		
293: 		// Create the abstract builder class.
294: 		job.builderAbstractType = findInnerClass(parent, job.builderClassName);
295: 		if (job.builderAbstractType == null) {
296: 			job.builderAbstractType = generateBuilderAbstractClass(job, superclassBuilderClass, superclassTypeParams, classGenericName, builderGenericName);
297: 			recursiveSetGeneratedBy(job.builderAbstractType.get(), annotationNode);
298: 		} else {
299: 			JCClassDecl builderTypeDeclaration = (JCClassDecl) job.builderAbstractType.get();
300: 			if (!builderTypeDeclaration.getModifiers().getFlags().contains(Modifier.STATIC)
301: 				|| !builderTypeDeclaration.getModifiers().getFlags().contains(Modifier.ABSTRACT)) {
302: 				
303: 				annotationNode.addError("Existing Builder must be an abstract static inner class.");
304: 				return;
305: 			}
306: 			sanityCheckForMethodGeneratingAnnotationsOnBuilderClass(job.builderAbstractType, annotationNode);
307: 			// Generate errors for @Singular BFDs that have one already defined node.
308: 			for (BuilderFieldData bfd : job.builderFields) {
309: 				SingularData sd = bfd.singularData;
310: 				if (sd == null) continue;
311: 				JavacSingularizer singularizer = sd.getSingularizer();
312: 				if (singularizer == null) continue;
313: 				if (singularizer.checkForAlreadyExistingNodesAndGenerateError(job.builderAbstractType, sd)) {
314: 					bfd.singularData = null;
315: 				}
316: 			}
317: 		}
318: 		
319: 		// Generate the fields in the abstract builder class that hold the values for the instance.
320: 		job.setBuilderToAbstract();
321: 		generateBuilderFields(job.builderType, job.builderFields, annotationNode);
322: 		if (addCleaning) {
323: 			JCVariableDecl uncleanField = maker.VarDef(maker.Modifiers(Flags.PRIVATE), job.toName("$lombokUnclean"), maker.TypeIdent(CTC_BOOLEAN), null);
324: 			recursiveSetGeneratedBy(uncleanField, annotationNode);
325: 			injectFieldAndMarkGenerated(job.builderType, uncleanField);
326: 		}
327: 		
328: 		if (job.toBuilder) {
329: 			// Generate $fillValuesFrom() method in the abstract builder.
330: 			JCMethodDecl fvm = generateFillValuesMethod(job, superclassBuilderClass != null, builderGenericName, classGenericName);
331: 			recursiveSetGeneratedBy(fvm, annotationNode);
332: 			injectMethod(job.builderType, fvm);
333: 			// Generate $fillValuesFromInstanceIntoBuilder() method in the builder implementation class.
334: 			JCMethodDecl sfvm = generateStaticFillValuesMethod(job, annInstance.setterPrefix());
335: 			recursiveSetGeneratedBy(sfvm, annotationNode);
336: 			injectMethod(job.builderType, sfvm);
337: 		}
338: 		
339: 		// Create the setter methods in the abstract builder.
340: 		for (BuilderFieldData bfd : job.builderFields) {
341: 			generateSetterMethodsForBuilder(job, bfd, builderGenericName, annInstance.setterPrefix());
342: 		}
343: 		
344: 		// Generate abstract self() and build() methods in the abstract builder.
345: 		JCMethodDecl asm = generateAbstractSelfMethod(job, superclassBuilderClass != null, builderGenericName);
346: 		recursiveSetGeneratedBy(asm, annotationNode);
347: 		injectMethod(job.builderType, asm);
348: 		JCMethodDecl abm = generateAbstractBuildMethod(job, superclassBuilderClass != null, classGenericName);
349: 		recursiveSetGeneratedBy(abm, annotationNode);
350: 		injectMethod(job.builderType, abm);
351: 		
352: 		// Create the toString() method for the abstract builder.
353: 		java.util.List<Included<JavacNode, ToString.Include>> fieldNodes = new ArrayList<Included<JavacNode, ToString.Include>>();
354: 		for (BuilderFieldData bfd : job.builderFields) {
355: 			for (JavacNode f : bfd.createdFields) {
356: 				fieldNodes.add(new Included<JavacNode, ToString.Include>(f, null, true, false));
357: 			}
358: 		}
359: 		
360: 		// Let toString() call super.toString() if there is a superclass, so that it also shows fields from the superclass' builder.
361: 		JCMethodDecl toStringMethod = HandleToString.createToString(job.builderType, fieldNodes, true, superclassBuilderClass != null, FieldAccess.ALWAYS_FIELD, annotationNode);
362: 		if (toStringMethod != null) injectMethod(job.builderType, toStringMethod);
363: 		
364: 		// If clean methods are requested, add them now.
365: 		if (addCleaning) {
366: 			JCMethodDecl md = generateCleanMethod(job.builderFields, job.builderType, annotationNode);
367: 			recursiveSetGeneratedBy(md, annotationNode);
368: 			injectMethod(job.builderType, md);
369: 		}
370: 		
371: 		boolean isAbstract = (td.mods.flags & Flags.ABSTRACT) != 0;
372: 		if (!isAbstract) {
373: 			// Only non-abstract classes get the Builder implementation.
374: 			
375: 			// Create the builder implementation class.
376: 			job.builderImplType = findInnerClass(parent, job.builderImplClassName);
377: 			if (job.builderImplType == null) {
378: 				job.builderImplType = generateBuilderImplClass(job);
379: 				recursiveSetGeneratedBy(job.builderImplType.get(), annotationNode);
380: 			} else {
381: 				JCClassDecl builderImplTypeDeclaration = (JCClassDecl) job.builderImplType.get();
382: 				if (!builderImplTypeDeclaration.getModifiers().getFlags().contains(Modifier.STATIC)
383: 						|| builderImplTypeDeclaration.getModifiers().getFlags().contains(Modifier.ABSTRACT)) {
384: 					annotationNode.addError("Existing BuilderImpl must be a non-abstract static inner class.");
385: 					return;
386: 				}
387: 				sanityCheckForMethodGeneratingAnnotationsOnBuilderClass(job.builderImplType, annotationNode);
388: 			}
389: 
390: 			// Create a simple constructor for the BuilderImpl class.
391: 			JCMethodDecl cd = HandleConstructor.createConstructor(AccessLevel.PRIVATE, List.<JCAnnotation>nil(), job.builderImplType, List.<JavacNode>nil(), false, annotationNode);
392: 			if (cd != null) injectMethod(job.builderImplType, cd);
393: 			job.setBuilderToImpl();
394: 			
395: 			// Create the self() and build() methods in the BuilderImpl.
396: 			JCMethodDecl selfMethod = generateSelfMethod(job);
397: 			recursiveSetGeneratedBy(selfMethod, annotationNode);
398: 			injectMethod(job.builderType, selfMethod);
399: 			if (methodExists(job.buildMethodName, job.builderType, -1) == MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS) {
400: 				JCMethodDecl buildMethod = generateBuildMethod(job, buildMethodThrownExceptions);
401: 				recursiveSetGeneratedBy(buildMethod, annotationNode);
402: 				injectMethod(job.builderType, buildMethod);
403: 			}
404: 		}
405: 		
406: 		// Generate a constructor in the annotated class that takes a builder as argument.
407: 		if (!constructorExists(job.parentType, job.builderAbstractClassName)) {
408: 			job.setBuilderToAbstract();
409: 			generateBuilderBasedConstructor(job, superclassBuilderClass != null);
410: 		}
411: 		
412: 		if (!isAbstract) {
413: 			// Only non-abstract classes get the builder() and toBuilder() methods.
414: 			
415: 			// Add the builder() method to the annotated class.
416: 			// Allow users to specify their own builder() methods, e.g., to provide default values.
417: 			if (generateBuilderMethod && methodExists(job.builderMethodName, job.parentType, -1) != MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS) generateBuilderMethod = false;
418: 			if (generateBuilderMethod) {
419: 				JCMethodDecl builderMethod = generateBuilderMethod(job);
420: 				if (builderMethod != null) {
421: 					recursiveSetGeneratedBy(builderMethod, annotationNode);
422: 					injectMethod(job.parentType, builderMethod);
423: 				}
424: 			}
425: 	
426: 			// Add the toBuilder() method to the annotated class.
427: 			if (job.toBuilder) {
428: 				switch (methodExists(TO_BUILDER_METHOD_NAME, job.parentType, 0)) {
429: 				case EXISTS_BY_USER:
430: 					break;
431: 				case NOT_EXISTS:
432: 					JCMethodDecl md = generateToBuilderMethod(job);

434: 						recursiveSetGeneratedBy(md, annotationNode);
435: 						injectMethod(job.parentType, md);
436: 					}
437: 					break;
438: 				default:
439: 					// Should not happen.
440: 				}
441: 			}
442: 		}
443: 		
444: 		if (nonFinalNonDefaultedFields != null && generateBuilderMethod) {
445: 			for (JavacNode fieldNode : nonFinalNonDefaultedFields) {
446: 				fieldNode.addWarning("@SuperBuilder will ignore the initializing expression entirely. If you want the initializing expression to serve as default, add @Builder.Default. If it is not supposed to be settable during building, make the field final.");

448: 		}

453: 	 */
454: 	private JavacNode generateBuilderAbstractClass(SuperBuilderJob job, JCExpression superclassBuilderClass, List<JCExpression> superclassTypeParams, String classGenericName, String builderGenericName) {
455: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = job.parentType.getTreeMaker();
456: 		JCModifiers mods = maker.Modifiers(Flags.STATIC | Flags.ABSTRACT | Flags.PUBLIC);
457: 		
458: 		// Keep any type params of the annotated class.
459: 		ListBuffer<JCTypeParameter> allTypeParams = new ListBuffer<JCTypeParameter>();
460: 		allTypeParams.appendList(copyTypeParams(job.sourceNode, job.typeParams));
461: 		// Add builder-specific type params required for inheritable builders.
462: 		// 1. The return type for the build() method, named "C", which extends the annotated class.
463: 		JCExpression annotatedClass = namePlusTypeParamsToTypeReference(maker, job.parentType, job.typeParams);
464: 		
465: 		allTypeParams.append(maker.TypeParameter(job.toName(classGenericName), List.<JCExpression>of(annotatedClass)));
466: 		// 2. The return type for all setter methods, named "B", which extends this builder class.
467: 		Name builderClassName = job.toName(job.builderClassName);
468: 		ListBuffer<JCExpression> typeParamsForBuilder = getTypeParamExpressions(job.typeParams, maker, job.sourceNode);
469: 		typeParamsForBuilder.append(maker.Ident(job.toName(classGenericName)));
470: 		typeParamsForBuilder.append(maker.Ident(job.toName(builderGenericName)));
471: 		JCTypeApply typeApply = maker.TypeApply(namePlusTypeParamsToTypeReference(maker, job.parentType, builderClassName, false, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil()), typeParamsForBuilder.toList());
472: 		allTypeParams.append(maker.TypeParameter(job.toName(builderGenericName), List.<JCExpression>of(typeApply)));
473: 		
474: 		JCExpression extending = null;
475: 		if (superclassBuilderClass != null) {
476: 			// If the annotated class extends another class, we want this builder to extend the builder of the superclass.
477: 			// 1. Add the type parameters of the superclass.
478: 			typeParamsForBuilder = getTypeParamExpressions(superclassTypeParams, maker, job.sourceNode);
479: 			// 2. Add the builder type params <C, B>.
480: 			typeParamsForBuilder.append(maker.Ident(job.toName(classGenericName)));
481: 			typeParamsForBuilder.append(maker.Ident(job.toName(builderGenericName)));
482: 			extending = maker.TypeApply(superclassBuilderClass, typeParamsForBuilder.toList());
483: 		}
484: 		
485: 		JCClassDecl builder = maker.ClassDef(mods, builderClassName, allTypeParams.toList(), extending, List.<JCExpression>nil(), List.<JCTree>nil());
486: 		recursiveSetGeneratedBy(builder, job.sourceNode);
487: 		return injectType(job.parentType, builder);
488: 	}

516: 	/**
517: 	 * Generates a constructor that has a builder as the only parameter.
518: 	 * The values from the builder are used to initialize the fields of new instances.
519: 	 *
520: 	 * @param callBuilderBasedSuperConstructor
521: 	 *            If {@code true}, the constructor will explicitly call a super
522: 	 *            constructor with the builder as argument. Requires
523: 	 *            {@code builderClassAsParameter != null}.
524: 	 */
525: 	private void generateBuilderBasedConstructor(SuperBuilderJob job, boolean callBuilderBasedSuperConstructor) {
526: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = job.getTreeMaker();
527: 		
528: 		AccessLevel level = AccessLevel.PROTECTED;
529: 		
530: 		ListBuffer<JCStatement> statements = new ListBuffer<JCStatement>();
531: 		
532: 		Name builderVariableName = job.toName(BUILDER_VARIABLE_NAME);
533: 		for (BuilderFieldData bfd : job.builderFields) {
534: 			JCExpression rhs;
535: 			if (bfd.singularData != null && bfd.singularData.getSingularizer() != null) {
536: 				bfd.singularData.getSingularizer().appendBuildCode(bfd.singularData, bfd.originalFieldNode, job.sourceNode, statements, bfd.builderFieldName, "b");
537: 				rhs = maker.Ident(bfd.singularData.getPluralName());
538: 			} else {
539: 				rhs = maker.Select(maker.Ident(builderVariableName), bfd.builderFieldName);
540: 			}
541: 			JCFieldAccess fieldInThis = maker.Select(maker.Ident(job.toName("this")), bfd.rawName);
542: 			
543: 			JCStatement assign = maker.Exec(maker.Assign(fieldInThis, rhs));
544: 			
545: 			// In case of @Builder.Default, set the value to the default if it was not set in the builder.
546: 			if (bfd.nameOfSetFlag != null) {
547: 				JCFieldAccess setField = maker.Select(maker.Ident(builderVariableName), bfd.nameOfSetFlag);
548: 				fieldInThis = maker.Select(maker.Ident(job.toName("this")), bfd.rawName);
549: 				JCExpression parentTypeRef = namePlusTypeParamsToTypeReference(maker, job.parentType, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil());
550: 				JCAssign assignDefault = maker.Assign(fieldInThis, maker.Apply(typeParameterNames(maker, ((JCClassDecl) job.parentType.get()).typarams), maker.Select(parentTypeRef, bfd.nameOfDefaultProvider), List.<JCExpression>nil()));
551: 				statements.append(maker.If(setField, assign, maker.Exec(assignDefault)));
552: 			} else {
553: 				statements.append(assign);
554: 			}
555: 			
556: 			if (hasNonNullAnnotations(bfd.originalFieldNode)) {
557: 				JCStatement nullCheck = generateNullCheck(maker, bfd.originalFieldNode, job.sourceNode);
558: 				if (nullCheck != null) statements.append(nullCheck);
559: 			}
560: 		}
561: 		
562: 		List<JCAnnotation> annsOnMethod = job.checkerFramework.generateSideEffectFree() ? List.of(maker.Annotation(genTypeRef(job.parentType, CheckerFrameworkVersion.NAME__SIDE_EFFECT_FREE), List.<JCExpression>nil())) : List.<JCAnnotation>nil();
563: 		JCModifiers mods = maker.Modifiers(toJavacModifier(level), annsOnMethod);
564: 		
565: 		// Create a constructor that has just the builder as parameter.
566: 		ListBuffer<JCVariableDecl> params = new ListBuffer<JCVariableDecl>();
567: 		long flags = JavacHandlerUtil.addFinalIfNeeded(Flags.PARAMETER, job.getContext());
568: 		// First add all generics that are present on the parent type.
569: 		ListBuffer<JCExpression> typeParamsForBuilderParameter = getTypeParamExpressions(job.typeParams, maker, job.sourceNode);
570: 		// Now add the <?, ?>.
571: 		JCWildcard wildcard = maker.Wildcard(maker.TypeBoundKind(BoundKind.UNBOUND), null);
572: 		typeParamsForBuilderParameter.append(wildcard);
573: 		wildcard = maker.Wildcard(maker.TypeBoundKind(BoundKind.UNBOUND), null);
574: 		typeParamsForBuilderParameter.append(wildcard);
575: 		JCTypeApply paramType = maker.TypeApply(namePlusTypeParamsToTypeReference(maker, job.parentType, job.getBuilderClassName(), false, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil()), typeParamsForBuilderParameter.toList());
576: 		JCVariableDecl param = maker.VarDef(maker.Modifiers(flags), builderVariableName, paramType, null);
577: 		params.append(param);
578: 		
579: 		if (callBuilderBasedSuperConstructor) {
580: 			// The first statement must be the call to the super constructor.
581: 			JCMethodInvocation callToSuperConstructor = maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(),
582: 					maker.Ident(job.toName("super")),
583: 					List.<JCExpression>of(maker.Ident(builderVariableName)));
584: 			statements.prepend(maker.Exec(callToSuperConstructor));
585: 		}
586: 		
587: 		JCMethodDecl constr = recursiveSetGeneratedBy(maker.MethodDef(mods, job.toName("<init>"),
588: 			null, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil(), params.toList(), List.<JCExpression>nil(),
589: 			maker.Block(0L, statements.toList()), null), job.sourceNode);
590: 		
591: 		injectMethod(job.parentType, constr);
592: 	}

658: 	/**
659: 	 * Generates a <code>$fillValuesFrom()</code> method in the abstract builder class that looks
660: 	 * like this:
661: 	 * <pre>
662: 	 * protected B $fillValuesFrom(final C instance) {
663: 	 *     super.$fillValuesFrom(instance);
664: 	 *     FoobarBuilder.$fillValuesFromInstanceIntoBuilder(instance, this);
665: 	 *     return self();
666: 	 * }
667: 	 * </pre>
668: 	 */
669: 	private JCMethodDecl generateFillValuesMethod(SuperBuilderJob job, boolean inherited, String builderGenericName, String classGenericName) {
670: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = job.getTreeMaker();
671: 		List<JCAnnotation> annotations = List.nil();
672: 		if (inherited) {
673: 			JCAnnotation overrideAnnotation = maker.Annotation(genJavaLangTypeRef(job.builderType, "Override"), List.<JCExpression>nil());
674: 			annotations = List.of(overrideAnnotation);
675: 		}
676: 		JCModifiers modifiers = maker.Modifiers(Flags.PROTECTED, annotations);
677: 		Name name = job.toName(FILL_VALUES_METHOD_NAME);
678: 		JCExpression returnType = maker.Ident(job.toName(builderGenericName));
679: 		
680: 		JCExpression classGenericNameExpr = maker.Ident(job.toName(classGenericName));
681: 		JCVariableDecl param = maker.VarDef(maker.Modifiers(Flags.PARAMETER | Flags.FINAL), job.toName(INSTANCE_VARIABLE_NAME), classGenericNameExpr, null);
682: 
683: 		ListBuffer<JCStatement> body = new ListBuffer<JCStatement>();
684: 		
685: 		if (inherited) {
686: 			// Call super.
687: 			JCMethodInvocation callToSuper = maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(),
688: 				maker.Select(maker.Ident(job.toName("super")), name),
689: 				List.<JCExpression>of(maker.Ident(job.toName(INSTANCE_VARIABLE_NAME))));
690: 			body.append(maker.Exec(callToSuper));
691: 		}
692: 		
693: 		// Call the builder implemention's helper method that actually fills the values from the instance.
694: 		JCExpression ref = namePlusTypeParamsToTypeReference(maker, job.parentType, job.getBuilderClassName(), false, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil());
695: 		JCMethodInvocation callStaticFillValuesMethod = maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(),
696: 			maker.Select(ref, job.toName(STATIC_FILL_VALUES_METHOD_NAME)),
697: 			List.<JCExpression>of(maker.Ident(job.toName(INSTANCE_VARIABLE_NAME)), maker.Ident(job.toName("this"))));
698: 		body.append(maker.Exec(callStaticFillValuesMethod));
699: 		
700: 		JCReturn returnStatement = maker.Return(maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(), maker.Ident(job.toName(SELF_METHOD)), List.<JCExpression>nil()));
701: 		body.append(returnStatement);
702: 		JCBlock bodyBlock = maker.Block(0, body.toList());
703: 		
704: 		return maker.MethodDef(modifiers, name, returnType, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil(), List.of(param), List.<JCExpression>nil(), bodyBlock, null);
705: 	}

707: 	/**
708: 	 * Generates a <code>$fillValuesFromInstanceIntoBuilder()</code> method in
709: 	 * the builder implementation class that copies all fields from the instance
710: 	 * to the builder. It looks like this:
711: 	 * 
712: 	 * <pre>
713: 	 * protected B $fillValuesFromInstanceIntoBuilder(Foobar instance, FoobarBuilder<?, ?> b) {
714: 	 * 	b.field(instance.field);
715: 	 * }
716: 	 * </pre>
717: 	 */
718: 	private JCMethodDecl generateStaticFillValuesMethod(SuperBuilderJob job, String setterPrefix) {
719: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = job.getTreeMaker();
720: 		List<JCAnnotation> annotations = List.nil();
721: 		JCModifiers modifiers = maker.Modifiers(Flags.PRIVATE | Flags.STATIC, annotations);
722: 		Name name = job.toName(STATIC_FILL_VALUES_METHOD_NAME);
723: 		JCExpression returnType = maker.TypeIdent(CTC_VOID);
724: 		
725: 		// 1st parameter: "Foobar instance"
726: 		JCVariableDecl paramInstance = maker.VarDef(maker.Modifiers(Flags.PARAMETER | Flags.FINAL), job.toName(INSTANCE_VARIABLE_NAME), cloneSelfType(job.parentType), null);
727: 
728: 		// 2nd parameter: "FoobarBuilder<?, ?> b" (plus generics on the annotated type)
729: 		// First add all generics that are present on the parent type.
730: 		ListBuffer<JCExpression> typeParamsForBuilderParameter = getTypeParamExpressions(job.typeParams, maker, job.sourceNode);
731: 		// Now add the <?, ?>.
732: 		JCWildcard wildcard = maker.Wildcard(maker.TypeBoundKind(BoundKind.UNBOUND), null);
733: 		typeParamsForBuilderParameter.append(wildcard);
734: 		wildcard = maker.Wildcard(maker.TypeBoundKind(BoundKind.UNBOUND), null);
735: 		typeParamsForBuilderParameter.append(wildcard);
736: 		JCTypeApply builderType = maker.TypeApply(namePlusTypeParamsToTypeReference(maker, job.parentType, job.getBuilderClassName(), false, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil()), typeParamsForBuilderParameter.toList());
737: 		JCVariableDecl paramBuilder = maker.VarDef(maker.Modifiers(Flags.PARAMETER | Flags.FINAL), job.toName(BUILDER_VARIABLE_NAME), builderType, null);
738: 		
739: 		ListBuffer<JCStatement> body = new ListBuffer<JCStatement>();
740: 		
741: 		// Call the builder's setter methods to fill the values from the instance.
742: 		for (BuilderFieldData bfd : job.builderFields) {
743: 			JCExpressionStatement exec = createSetterCallWithInstanceValue(bfd, job, setterPrefix);
744: 			body.append(exec);
745: 		}
746: 		
747: 		JCBlock bodyBlock = maker.Block(0, body.toList());
748: 		
749: 		return maker.MethodDef(modifiers, name, returnType, copyTypeParams(job.builderType, job.typeParams), List.of(paramInstance, paramBuilder), List.<JCExpression>nil(), bodyBlock, null);
750: 	}

752: 	private JCExpressionStatement createSetterCallWithInstanceValue(BuilderFieldData bfd, SuperBuilderJob job, String setterPrefix) {
753: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = job.getTreeMaker();
754: 		JCExpression[] tgt = new JCExpression[bfd.singularData == null ? 1 : 2];
755: 		if (bfd.obtainVia == null || !bfd.obtainVia.field().isEmpty()) {
756: 			for (int i = 0; i < tgt.length; i++) {
757: 				tgt[i] = maker.Select(maker.Ident(job.toName(INSTANCE_VARIABLE_NAME)), bfd.obtainVia == null ? bfd.rawName : job.toName(bfd.obtainVia.field()));
758: 			}
759: 		} else {
760: 			if (bfd.obtainVia.isStatic()) {
761: 				for (int i = 0; i < tgt.length; i++) {
762: 					JCExpression typeRef = namePlusTypeParamsToTypeReference(maker, job.parentType, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil());
763: 					JCExpression c = maker.Select(typeRef, job.toName(bfd.obtainVia.method()));
764: 					tgt[i] = maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(), c, List.<JCExpression>of(maker.Ident(job.toName(INSTANCE_VARIABLE_NAME))));
765: 				}
766: 			} else {
767: 				for (int i = 0; i < tgt.length; i++) {
768: 					JCExpression c = maker.Select(maker.Ident(job.toName(INSTANCE_VARIABLE_NAME)), job.toName(bfd.obtainVia.method()));
769: 					tgt[i] = maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(), c, List.<JCExpression>nil());
770: 				}
771: 			}
772: 		}
773: 		
774: 		JCExpression arg;
775: 		if (bfd.singularData == null) {
776: 			arg = tgt[0];
777: 		} else {
778: 			JCExpression eqNull = maker.Binary(CTC_EQUAL, tgt[0], maker.Literal(CTC_BOT, null));
779: 			JCExpression emptyCollection = bfd.singularData.getSingularizer().getEmptyExpression(bfd.singularData.getTargetFqn(), maker, bfd.singularData, job.parentType, job.sourceNode);
780: 			arg = maker.Conditional(eqNull, emptyCollection, tgt[1]);
781: 		}
782: 		
783: 		String setterName = HandlerUtil.buildAccessorName(job.sourceNode, setterPrefix, bfd.name.toString());
784: 		JCMethodInvocation apply = maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(), maker.Select(maker.Ident(job.toName(BUILDER_VARIABLE_NAME)), job.toName(setterName)), List.of(arg));
785: 		JCExpressionStatement exec = maker.Exec(apply);
786: 		return exec;
787: 	}

789: 	private JCMethodDecl generateAbstractSelfMethod(SuperBuilderJob job, boolean override, String builderGenericName) {

804: 	private JCMethodDecl generateSelfMethod(SuperBuilderJob job) {
805: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = job.getTreeMaker();
